The five artists with the most albums are:

1. Iron Maiden (ArtistId 90) — 21 albums
2. Led Zeppelin (ArtistId 22) — 14 albums
3. Deep Purple (ArtistId 58) — 11 albums
4. Metallica (ArtistId 50) — 10 albums
5. U2 (ArtistId 150) — 10 albums

Note: Metallica and U2 are tied with 10 albums each; I listed them both to show the top 5 by count.
sql_used:
SELECT a.ArtistId, a.Name, COUNT(*) AS album_count
FROM Artist a
JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name
ORDER BY album_count DESC, a.Name
LIMIT 5;
assumptions: "Most albums" means the highest number of rows in the Album table per ArtistId.
